edges.reason: transfer passes msg.sender as the source account into transferFrom
transferFrom reads msg.sender to check spender identity and decrement allowance
approve writes the allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender
constructor assigns msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder
delegate guards execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
init guards execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend guards execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress guards execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
ensure returns true immediately when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing condition
owner state variable is the authorization subject for delegate
owner state variable is the authorization subject for batchSend
owner state variable is the authorization subject for setTradeAddress
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address
ensure consults canSale[_from] to grant a whitelist bypass
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress for whitelisting
ensure/condition path is gated by canSale and _onSaleNum state
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition reads _saleNum to limit sales per address
condition reads _minSale to reject small transfers
condition reads _maxSale to reject large transfers

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter only exists to flow into transferFrom arithmetic, so it is collapsed into the transferFrom function node
The _from parameter only indexes balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom, so it is collapsed into transferFrom
The _to parameter is the recipient of transfer and is merged into the transfer entrypoint
The _tos array parameter is consumed only by batchSend and is merged into that function node
The local total variable is a computed intermediate of batchSend and is merged into batchSend
The addr parameter is assigned directly to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress and is merged into it
The a parameter is the delegatecall target in delegate and is merged into the delegate function
The b parameter is the raw calldata consumed by the unsafe delegatecall operation and is merged into it
